lines.en: I bounce along.

lines.zh: 我的身体在跳的时候压扁
lines.en: My body flattens with every hop.
I hop low, but often.
I land and splash a ring of water outward.
I bounce past your feet.

lines.zh: 我一跳，身上的东西晃了一下
lines.en: Something inside me sloshes when I jump.
I ooze forward a little.
I creep toward the light.
I hop up and land where I was.
I bounce down the steps.

lines.zh: 我的身体在石缝里挤过
lines.en: My body squeezes through a crevice.
I bounce closer, hop by hop.
I rise and fall gently on the ground.
My surface keeps moving.
My mind is empty.
It is a little cold here.
I wait for someone to come by.
I press myself into a circle.
My edge slowly spreads.
I lie spread out, not moving.
There is something inside me.
I tremble, or something like it.
I press to the ground and listen.
I swell slowly.
I make a very small sound.
I like this spot.

lines.zh: 我抬头只看到你的膝盖
lines.en: I look up and only reach your knee.
I raise myself a little to look at you.
You would slip if you stepped on me.
I am a little too close to you.
Your hands have a smell.
I am wondering what you will do.
I bounce once, away.
Do not raise your foot to test me.

lines.zh: 我身上没有什么值钱的
lines.en: There is nothing of value in me.

lines.zh: 你这样看着我，我有点怕
lines.en: You looking at me like that frightens me.
I shift into the shade.
I dare not move first.

lines.zh: 我缩在你影子里不敢动
lines.en: I huddle in your shadow and keep still.
I could stand like this forever.
Small bubbles rise on my surface.
I narrow my body slowly.
Only one step between us.
I look up, waiting for you to go.
I got squashed.
A corner of me has broken into a puddle.
I gather myself back.
That one hurt.
I wobble all over.
There is a dent in me.

lines.zh: 我把自己捏成一颗珠子
lines.en: I squeeze myself into a tiny bead.
I shift toward the shade.
I am still spread out here.
I have noted that squash.
Could that dissolve into me?
I seep toward it.
I am not sure I can eat it.
Put it down and I will try.
It is much brighter than I am.
I bounce up once.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够我裹一圈
lines.en: This isn't enough to coat me even once.
Let me touch it first.
I am not picky; I dissolve anything.
Do not bring your hand that near.
Your foot is on me.
I am squashed and swell back.
You nearly slipped.
I stick to your sole.
I bounce up and land with a wet smack.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我晃得厉害
lines.en: We collide and I wobble hard.
I scatter a little and gather again.
I flatten for a moment, then puff back up.

lines.zh: 我从你的鞋尖旁边溜过
lines.en: I slip past the tip of your boot.
Do not step again.
We press together.
Two of us become one lump.
I cannot tell which part is me.
I am too small to understand.
We are only lying close.
I slowly come apart.
I do not think about such things.
I bounce away.

lines.zh: 我只是往你那边贴了贴
lines.en: I only press a little closer to you.
I split in two and flow back together.
I have folded it in.
It is slowly dissolving.

lines.zh: 我裹了两圈还是吞不下
lines.en: Two wraps around it, and I still can't swallow.
I cannot swallow it; it is stuck.

lines.zh: 我推了半天才把它挤出
lines.en: I shove for ages before it squeezes out.
Whoever dropped it, perfect timing.
It floats inside me.
I hop along with it inside me.
I do not really need it.
I slowly push it out.
You stepped on me.
Once I fix on you, my eyes stay.
My surface suddenly pulls tight.
I will bounce into you.
This is where I stay.
You have crowded me into a corner.
I swell up little by little.
I do not like being stepped on.
I am set to bounce.
Do not come any closer.
I count only to three.

lines.zh: 我鼓起身子对准你的脚
lines.en: I swell up and aim at your feet.
I press myself tight.
I made the first move.
You have some of me on you.
I am coming at you.
My edge reaches out.
Do not dodge this.
I close in, hop by hop.

lines.zh: 我把你脚下的地弄湿了
lines.en: I've made the ground under you wet.
You step back, I hop.
I cling to the floor; hard to step on.
I count every time you lift a foot.
I count your movements.

lines.zh: 我的身体一波一波地动
lines.en: My body ripples.

lines.zh: 我贴在地上记你的脚步
lines.en: Flat on the ground, I memorize your footsteps.
I seep forward slowly.
You have stood beside me too long.
I creep a tiny bit closer.
I have spread across this floor.
Do you hear that small sound?
One last hop.
I draw myself in.
I am ready on my side.
I am in the air.
Landing is the strike.
I have stuck to your leg.
The moment has come.
I slap my whole body against your ankle.
I stick to your sleeve.
You had to shake twice to free it.
That was not very heavy.
I bounce up and cling again.

lines.zh: 我的身体在你鞋上摊开
lines.en: I spread over your shoe.
The stickiness slows you.
I bounce back.
That one was slippery.
I am not much good at fighting.
I press down on your foot.
You pulled your leg back.
My edge is sticky.

lines.zh: 我的手黏住了你的裤脚
lines.en: My hand has stuck to your trouser leg.
Do not step on me again.
I ooze off to one side.
A small lump rises from the ground.
I bounce once and settle.
This spot looks fine.
A small lump of me squeezes out of the crack.
I gather into shape.
I still carry mud from elsewhere.
I look up and see the sky.
I will stay here a while.
I am small and soft-bodied.
I wobble and spread out.
I picked a shadow.
I do not know anything.
I make a squelching sound.
I ooze into the middle of the path.
It is quiet, so I lie here.

lines.zh: 我只想占住这一小块地
lines.en: I only want this little patch of ground.
I have pressed myself quite flat.
I am here already.
Fire has dried my edges.
I splatter off the steps.
I scatter in the water and can't gather again.
The blast splatters me wide.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过去，留下一个洞
lines.en: An arrow punches a hole through me.
Magic leaves me trembling.
There is nothing left around me.

lines.zh: 雷落在近旁，我一下弹起
lines.en: Lightning lands close and I bounce up.

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，我也散了
lines.en: The ground is gone, and I come apart.
